structure.unit: Organization, Admission and Licensing of Insurers
Conversion of Domestic Stock Insurer to Mutual Insurer

law.catch_line: Conversion of a domestic stock insurer to a mutual insurer

text.section: For the purpose of this article, "policyholder" shall include the employer, or the president, secretary or other executive officer of any corporation or association, to which a master group policy has been issued, but shall exclude the holders of certificates or policies issued under or in connection with a master group policy.
